content: Depit Keidiong en Nanmwarki

KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Samuel, “Ia erein omw pahn kin nsensuwedki Sohl? I soikasangehr en wia nanmwarkien Israel. Eri, wahda ekis kisin lehn olip en. Pwe I pahn kadaruhkowohng Pedleem, rehn ohl emen ede Sehsi, pwe I piladahr emen nah pwutak pwe en wiahla nanmwarki.”

Samuel eri patohwan idek, “Ia duwen ei kak wie soahngen? Ma Sohl pahn rongada, e pahn kemeiehla.” KAUN-O ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Wahda emen koupwulen, ke ahpw nda me ke kohkolahng wia meirong ong KAUN-O.
Ke ahpw luke Sehsi ong ni meirongo. Eri, I ahpw pahn ndaiong uhk dahme ke pahn wia. Ke pahn keiehdi ohl me I pahn pilada pwe en nanmwarki.”

Samuel eri wiahda nin duwen me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong. Ih eri patopatohla Pedleem, wasa me kaunen kahnimwo tuhwong ih ie, oh wie rerrerki ar masepwehk. Re ahpw idek, “Maing, komw ketikihdo popohl, de dah?”

E ahpw sapeng irail, ketihtihki, “Ei, I wahdo meleilei. I kohdohn wia meirong ong KAUN-O. Kumwail kamwakeleikumwailda oh kohdo iang ie.” E pil padahkihong Sehsi oh nah pwutak ko re en kamwakelda; e ahpw pil lukeirailohng ni meirongo.
Eri, ni ar lel wasao, Samuel ahpw kilangada nein Sehsi nah pwutak Eliap. E ahpw mengimengloalki, “Ohl menet me kesikesihnen mwohn silangin KAUN-O, ele iei ih ohl me e ketin piladahr.”

A KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Samuel, “Ke dehr tehk duwen eh reirei oh masamwahu. Pwe kaidehk ih me I piladahr. Pwehki I sohte kin kasawih aramas nin duwen me aramas akan kin wia. Aramas kin kasawih mwomwen aramas, ahpw ngehi, I kin kasawih nan mohngiong en aramas akan.”
Sehsi ahpw ekerodo nah pwutak Apinadap oh kasalehiong Samuel. Samuel ahpw ketihtihki, “Soh! KAUN-O sohte ketin pilada ih.”
Sehsi ahpw pil kasalehiong Samma. A Samuel pil ketihtihki, “Soh! Kaidehn ih me KAUN-O ketin pilada.”
Ih duwen Sehsi eh kasalehiong Samuel nah pwutak isimeno. A Samuel ahpw ketihtihkihong, “Soh, kaidehk! KAUN-O sohte ketin pilada emen irail pwukat.”

Samuel eri idek rehn Sehsi, “Ihte noumwi pwutak kan met, solahr pil emen?” Sehsi ahpw sapeng, “Mie emen me keieu tikitik, ahpw e sohte iang mi met, pwe e sinsile nait sihpw kan.” Samuel eri ketihtihki, “Komw ekerodo. Kitail sohte pahn wia atail meirong e lao leledo.”
Sehsi eri ileklahng en kohdo. Mwahnakapw pwulopwul men ih, masamwahu, paliwaramwahu, oh mas pwukapwuk. KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Samuel, “Iei ih met—keiehdi!”
Samuel eri ale lehn olipo oh keiehdi Depit mwohn mesen rie ko. Ngenen KAUN-O eri ti pohn Depit oh ketin ieiang sang rahno kohla. Samuel eri pwurala Rama.
Depit nan Tehnpas en Sohl
Ngenen KAUN-O ahpw ketieisang rehn Sohl; a ngehn suwed ehu me KAUN-O ketin kadarodo ahpw kaloke.
Sapwellime papah ko eri patohwanohng, “Se patohwan ese me ngehn suwed sang ni mweimweien Koht me kapwunodeikomwidahr.
Komw mahsanih pwe se en rapahkihdo emen ohlen me ese kesengki arp, pwe ni ngehn suwedo eh pahn kin ti pohmwi, ohl menet en kin kesengiong komwi. Komwi ahpw pahn kupwuramwahukihla.”
Sohl eri mahsanih, “Nna, kumwail rapahkihda aramas emen me kadek keseng, oh kahrehdo rehi.”

Eri, emen sapwellime papah ko ahpw patohwan, “Sehsi, mehn Pedleem, mie nah pwutak emen me inenen kadek keseng. Me pil ohl dengngang men, sounpei kommwad, kadek lokaia, oh paliwaramwahu. KAUN-O kin ketin ieiang.”
Sohl eri poaronehla meninkeder kei rehn Sehsi, mahsanih, “Komw kadarodohng ie mahs noumwi pwutak Depit, silepen sihpw kan.”
Sehsi eri kadarala Depit rehn Sohl, iangahkihla ehd kilin mahn me diren wain, kuht pwulopwul men, oh ahs emen me wa kiden pilawa.
Depit eri kohla rehn Sohl oh tapiada papah. Sohl ahpw inenen poakepoakehla Depit oh kin mweidohng en kin weuwa sapwellime dipwisoun mahwen kan.
Sohl ahpw ketin kadaralahng Sehsi pakair wet: “I kesempwaliki Depit. Komw mweidohng pwe en kin mihmi rehi oh doadoahkohng ie.”

Eri, sang rahno kohla, ahnsou koaros me ngehn suwed me Koht ketin kadarodo kin ti pohn Sohl, Depit kin ale nah arp oh kesengki. Ngehn suwedo ahpw kin kohieisang, oh Sohl ahpw kin nsenamwahula oh pwurehng kehlailda.
